scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-validators.mjs && node scripts/build-configurator.mjs && cf workers types --include-runtime
scripts.build: cf build && npm --prefix auth run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --project tsconfig.access.json
scripts.test: npm run generate && tsx --test test/*.test.ts && tsx test/runtime.ts && tsx test/access-runtime.ts
